title: Demo: record a demo's tape
description: Self-referential: invokes `nexus demo record` against DEMO-01-cluster-status, producing a VHS `.tape` file (and a GIF if `vhs` is on PATH). Confirms the record pipeline is wired correctly with the AOT-built binary.

observe.what: tape file path · output GIF path (if vhs available) or vhs install hint (if not)
`.tape` file present; `.gif` present iff vhs is on PATH

whatProves: DemoRunner generates VHS `.tape` scripts correctly + the vhs-availability fallback message is operator-actionable when vhs is missing.
